_doc.zh: 语音合成的示范片段：机器合成的声音（24 kHz、单声道、16 位）和它的音素时间线，格式和后端 /api/tts 返回的相同（phonemes、words）。没有后端时界面用这些片段。stats 里的 stopClosureDiffMs / stopReleaseDiffMs 是时间线的粗检：塞音处声音能量骤降 / 骤升的时刻减去时间线上塞音的起点 / 终点（毫秒）。
_doc.en: Speech-synthesis demo clips: machine-generated audio (24 kHz, mono, 16-bit) with its phoneme timeline, in the format the backend's /api/tts returns (phonemes, words). The UI uses these clips when there is no backend. stopClosureDiffMs / stopReleaseDiffMs under `stats` are a rough check on the timeline: the moment the audio's energy falls / rises at a stop minus the start / end of that stop in the timeline (ms).
